definitions.short: properly, salted (i.e. land), i.e. a desert
definitions.full: H4420. melechah מְלֵחָה noun feminine saltness, barrenness ; — Job 39:6 (|| עֲרָבָה ) as dwelling-place of wild ass, salt-plain ; מְלֵחָה אֶרֶץ Jer 17:6 (|| תֵשֵׁב לֹא ); Psa 107:34 (opposed to מְּרִי אֶרֶץ ).
definitions.rootNote: from 4414 (in its denominative sense); understood as land ( 776 )
